title: Jeremy Grantham
html: Who: Co-founder of GMO, known for calling the 2000 and 2008 bubbles. Core ideas: Prices revert to fair value over time; bubbles show extreme valuations plus euphoria plus narrowing leadership. For our plan: Watch market breadth — Goldman says the median S&P 500 stock was ~16% below its high in late Sept 2026 while the index sat near records. That's a Grantham-style warning sign worth tracking. Back to Council of Masters
